correctness.rationale: The symmetric nodal L2 Gram matrix is Mii=deg(i)/3 and Mij=1/6 for adjacent vertices. Decomposition into class constants and zero-sum modes yields the claimed u,v,-x,-y coefficients in the large-part row. Each edge contributes (a²+b²)/(2(a+b)) for opposite-sign endpoint kernel values, and the five edge orbits give the boxed sharp norm. Competing small-class and singleton row values are dominated using four exact rational positivity-certificate regions; independently recomputed symbolic numerator/denominator coefficient positivity in 189/225,99/115,143/156,104/105 terms. Finite exact dense Gram inverses for sizes 2..9 confirm endpoint norms. The strict interior triangle-inequality argument and threshold positivity certify norm<2 iff q<=3, norm>2 iff q>=4, and limit 7/3.
